title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
author: Jingjie Ning, Xueqi Li, Yi Lu, Yibo Kong
description: Reusable Web-agent verification requires a rule to follow changing requirements and support subsequent execution. We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings. The resource spans 97 tasks, 79 families, and four Web services.…
summary: Reusable Web-agent verification requires a rule to follow changing requirements and support subsequent execution. We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings.
takeaways: We introduce AgentProofBench, which connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings.

Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs; paired reuse-rebuild BA intervals are [-5.47, 1.57] and [-10.16, 0.00] percentage points.
Released instructions, states, programs, reference rules, and trajectories connect each test failure to its execution consequences.
